info.title: MindCloud Public API
info.description: REST surface under /v2. Authenticate with a company-scoped API key sent as a bearer token. Each key holds a set of permissions; each operation lists the ones it requires as the apiKey security roles. A request may use a permission only while the user who created the key also holds it.

get.summary: List workflows for the company with filtering, sorting, and pagination
get.description:
List workflows for the company with filtering, sorting, and pagination. The workflow definition is only available on the detail endpoint.

Each filterable field is also a query parameter: `status=active` matches it exactly, and bracket operators (eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains, starts, ends, in, nin) compare, e.g. `createdOn[gte]=2026-01-01` or `status[in]=failed,cancelled`. contains, starts, and ends apply to text fields only.

Requires the API key permission workflow:view.
